data.summary:
As [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) begins, or as [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) begins, you can Empower this unit by spending 1 [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). While it is Empowered, it gets the benefit of each model type below that it contains:

- Lhamaean models: the melee weapons its models carry get **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**
- Medusae models: the ranged weapons its models carry get **[[IGNORES COVER]](vsdata:weapon-ability/ignores-cover)**
- Sslyth models: melee attacks against it get -1 to Wound
- Ur-ghul models: it gets **[Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first)**
